new_page.title: Richmond Houses for Sale | Seafair to Steveston
new_page.description: Search Richmond detached houses for sale. Compare Seafair, Steveston, Broadmoor and Granville sold prices, and see what the 2024 RSM rezoning changed.

faq.q: How much does a house cost in Richmond?
faq.a: It depends on the neighbourhood. Among neighbourhoods with 10 or more sales, medians ran from $1,198,800 in Hamilton to $2,428,000 in Seafair. The benchmark price for a typical Richmond detached home was $1,871,100 in September 2026.

faq.q: Which Richmond neighbourhood has the most house sales?
faq.a: Seafair, with 47 sales and a median of $2,428,000. Granville was second with 39.

faq.q: What are the RSM zones in Richmond?
faq.a: RSM/S, RSM/M, RSM/L and RSM/XL are the four zones Richmond Council created on June 24, 2024 for almost 27,000 former single-family and duplex lots. Check the lot’s current zone on the City’s map.

faq.q: Does the 2024 rezoning apply around the five station areas?
faq.a: No. The areas around the Bridgeport, Capstan, Aberdeen, Lansdowne and Brighouse stations are excluded from it and have their own rules.

faq.q: Are Richmond houses at risk of flooding?
faq.a: The city is protected by 49 kilometres of dikes. The City also notes pockets of liquefaction are possible in a significant earthquake. Ask for the foundation report on an older house.

faq.q: How long does it take to sell a house in Richmond?
faq.a: It varies by neighbourhood: 19 days in Steveston North, 48 in Steveston South and 65 in Quilchena at a median.

blocks.text: This search lists detached houses for sale across Richmond, from Steveston in the south-west to Hamilton in the east. Condos and townhomes have their own searches, linked at the bottom of the page.

521 Richmond houses closed in the year to October 22, 2026, spread over 23 neighbourhoods. The sold records I use report Richmond by neighbourhood, so there is no single city median here: the table below gives each neighbourhood’s own figure, and the Home Price Index benchmark for a typical Richmond detached home was $1,871,100 in September 2026.
Where Richmond houses sold, and how fast

Seafair had the highest median price among neighbourhoods with 10 or more sales, $2,428,000, and Hamilton the lowest, $1,198,800. The gap between them is $1,229,200. The most active neighbourhood was Seafair with 47 sales, ahead of Granville with 39.

blocks.text: Speed varies as much as price. Steveston South houses took 48 days at a median and Steveston North 19. Quilchena took 65 days, the slowest in the table. Steveston Village is the small-lot end of the Steveston area at 20 sales and $822 a square foot, against $739 in Seafair.

Lot size explains a lot of the price. The median Steveston South house sat on 4,028 sq ft, against 8,115 sq ft in Broadmoor and 7,199 sq ft in Granville. Seafair, at 7,035 sq ft, has newer homes (median built 2011) than Granville (1980).

blocks.text: On June 24, 2024 Richmond Council rezoned almost 27,000 single-family and duplex lots into four new zones: RSM/S, RSM/M, RSM/L and RSM/XL. About 84% of those lots had been RS1/A, RS1/B or RS1/E, the city’s standard single-family lots. The City’s zoning bylaw is No. 8500.

Five transit-oriented areas, around the Bridgeport, Capstan, Aberdeen, Lansdowne and Brighouse stations, were left out of that rezoning because they have their own plans. If a house you like is close to one of those stations, ask which rules apply before you count on extra units.

Richmond is an island city and 49 kilometres of dikes protect it. Richmond Fire-Rescue says pockets of liquefaction are possible in a significant earthquake, so a geotechnical question is a fair one to ask about any older house on soft ground. East of No. 4 Road the land falls into the Agricultural Land Reserve, which includes the Garden City Lands, and those parcels follow Reserve rules rather than the city’s house-lot zones.
Questions to ask before you offer on a Richmond house

items.t: What is the lot’s zone now? Many former RS1 lots became one of the four RSM zones in 2024.
Is the house inside one of the five station areas that were left out of the rezoning?
Is the lot east of No. 4 Road? If so, check Agricultural Land Reserve status.
Has the house had a geotechnical or foundation report? Ask, especially for homes near the dikes.
